##### Project general facts

Christian A. Rockefeller Business Tower is a landmark Grade A commercial tower, developed by LMD and carrying the Christian A. Rockefeller name. Conceived as an architectural icon designed to redefine the commercial skyline, the tower offers a prestigious collection of offices ranging from Prime and Elite suites to Executive half-floor and Presidential full-floor headquarters. Office floors are arranged by height, with fewer offices per floor on the upper levels for greater calm and city and sea views.

Hotel-inspired amenities are spread across dedicated levels of the tower. The Reset brings together a spa with private treatment rooms, an ice room, sauna and steam rooms, a padel court, an infinity pool with cabanas and a sun bed terrace, a sensory walk and a meditation area, while a juice bar and lounge, a fully equipped gym and a multipurpose studio complete the wellness offer. At the top of the tower, The Exchange and The Observatory combine a ballroom with a pre-function space, co-working space, meeting rooms, podcast rooms, quiet pods, an outdoor bar and an additional infinity pool, and on-site dining and retail serve occupants throughout the day.

State-of-the-art technology and advanced security systems support daily operations, creating a distinguished business environment designed to elevate corporate identity, prestige and influence. The tower is designed to attract leading regional and international companies looking for a world-class workplace.

##### Location description and benefits

Business Bay is one of Dubai's key business districts, positioned along Sheikh Zayed Road between DIFC and Downtown Dubai. Burj Khalifa, The Dubai Fountain, Dubai Opera, the Museum of the Future and the Dubai Canal are all close by.

Dubai Mall Metro Station and Business Bay Metro Station are close by, and Sheikh Zayed Road, Al Mustaqbal Street and Al Khail Road connect the area with the rest of the city and Dubai International Airport. The Dubai Mall, Souk Al Bahar, Time Out Market, City Walk, DIFC and Dubai Design District offer dining, shopping and culture nearby.

Business Bay is a freehold area and a prestigious corporate address within one of Dubai's most established business corridors. The district attracts owner-occupiers and investors seeking attractive rental yields and potential for capital appreciation in the premium office market.
